items.title: Stop leaking API keys through axios error logs and harden log redaction
items.summary:
## Overview

The backend calls credentialed APIs (NewsAPI, FRED, Pinata via axios; Anthropic and Gemini via SDKs) and logs failures by passing raw errors to pino. Axios errors carry `config` (`url`, `params`, `headers`), and pino's standard `err` serializer copies enumerable properties, so all of it reaches the log line.
